item.title: Blurts
item.description: Blurts is the app I’m building for thoughts that arrive when your hands are already full. Say what’s on your mind, even if it comes out messy, and turn it into clear tasks you can act on. The question Can capturing a task be as easy as saying it out loud, without creating another system to maintain? What I’m exploring The work goes beyond writing the app: making voice capture feel natural, simplifying the experience, listening to the people using it, and figuring out how to reach more of them.

item.title: Writing in public
item.description: The starting point was simple: publish something instead of waiting until it felt perfect. I joined Ship 30 for 30 to organize my thoughts, build a writing habit, and share what I was learning about Android development, developer experience, and productivity. This is the collection of published entries. The dates tell the actual story: the writing continued beyond the original 30-day intention.
